fingerprintConventions.inputs: SHA-256 over UTF-8 with only CRLF converted to LF for ts, tsx, mts, js, json, csv, tsv, txt, xml, md, R, py and soft files. Other extensions and non-UTF8 text use exact bytes. This applies only to this ledger input inventory.
fingerprintConventions.sourceEvidence: Original source, acquisition, replay and reviewed-unit file pins are validated against exact bytes independently of the ledger inventory. Atlas saved-output evidence explicitly uses sha256-utf8-crlf-to-lf-v1.

coverage: Current local inputs and default-track bundles for original non-atlas datasets; all 22 tracks and 51 comparisons in the fourteen-dataset September intake are assessed. All current macaque atlas app tracks have a dedicated saved-output audit. Missing data never pass. Raw sequencing read quality and unrecorded biological confounders remain outside this audit. Atlas raw count processing remains unverified without its original objects.

policy.aggregation: Every required applicable check must pass. Failure takes priority over review, then missing evidence. Not-applicable checks are neutral.
policy.replication: At least three distinct recorded biological units per arm; two require review; fewer than two fail. Reused units require model review.
